The hospital infrastructure and accommodation are satisfactory, but the overall medical experience was quite disappointing. The doctors appeared more interested in recommending tests rather than understanding the patient’s condition. Despite multiple examinations, there was no effective diagnosis or relief.

A close family member was admitted for three days, yet no meaningful treatment was provided. When we raised concerns, the hospital advised us to shift the patient. After moving to another facility, the patient’s recovery improved significantly — nearly 90% within a short time.

I’m writing to express my gratitude and provide feedback following my mother’s recent hospitalization at Shree Sai hospital

First and foremost, I want to sincerely thank the medical staff, especially the nurses and doctors in the for their dedication, professionalism, and compassion throughout her stay. The care and attention she received made a stressful time much more manageable for our family.

The hospital environment was clean and well-maintained, and the staff was always available to answer questions or provide reassurance. We especially appreciated the clear communication regarding her treatment and progress.

featured_reviews.name: Natasha Gracious
featured_reviews.review_text:
Getting my mum admitted to Shree Sai for her MIS TLIF of Spine, is the best decision I made for her. Contrary to popular opinion about the hospitals in Vasai and their infamy regarding the treatment and billing of patients, also the survival rate, Shree Sai Hospital has proved otherwise. The admission was smooth-sailing. I had to do absolutely nothing. The change of room was a cherry on the cake. The RMOs - Dr. Vivek, Dr. Rishi, Dr. Lakshmi are extremely genuine, friendly, warm and caring
..so many rounds in a day for a patient, never seen it in any hospital. The nurses - Trupti, Nikita, Usha, Jasvina - they're human dolls. Trupti and Nikita are gems in their caring for a patient and their devotion to a job. Prem, Gulshan, Manju - even though housekeeping, they became family in no time. Dr. Padmaraj Patil, pays regular visits to every patient. Shree Sai is a no-frills hospital, but the treatment my mum got here is better than any huge corporate could give. This hospital proves that you don't need visitor passes and a ton of security to keep a patient safe.

The only negative is lack of hygiene. I'd give a minus for the hygiene. Garbage bin is kept just three steps from my mum's room in a place called "Utility waste". The garbage from every room is collected and just tossed in it. The employees even eat bananas and throw the skin in it. Rats are frequent visitors of this eternally open bin.
Commode in the deluxe room is absolutely low grade and dirty. The cleaners who empty the urine bag desperately need to be trained in cleanliness.

All you need is such genuine doctors and nurses and most of all humanity, to take a person of a most risky spine surgery home...lastly...the discharge is butter...I'm doing nothing at all....Thank you so very much, Team Shree Sai...
